name: Renamed Powershell Under Powershell Channel
description: Detects a renamed Powershell execution, which is a common technique used to circumvent security controls and bypass detection logic that's dependent on process names and process paths.
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.event_data.Data:*HostName\=ConsoleHost* AND (NOT ((winlog.event_data.Data:(*HostApplication\=powershell* OR *HostApplication\=C\:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell* OR *HostApplication\=C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell* OR *HostApplication\=C\:\/Windows\/System32\/WindowsPowerShell\/v1.0\/powershell* OR *HostApplication\=C\:\/Windows\/SysWOW64\/WindowsPowerShell\/v1.0\/powershell* OR *HostApplication\=C\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\system32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1.0\\\\powershell.exe* OR *HostApplication\=C\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1.0\\\\powershell.exe*)) OR winlog.event_data.Data:/HostId=[a-zA-Z0-9-]{36}\s+EngineVersion=/))
